need: The page lists what the world builder added to make a world run apart from what it left out.

searched.query: not_modeled, Left out of the simulation
searched.found: One list (not_modeled) is the only channel; nothing carries additions.

searched.query: builder assumptions, added items, left-out list
searched.found: Nothing listed for separating added items from unrepresented ones.

searched.query: LLM generated simulation world report assumptions added versus omitted from description structured output field
searched.found: No tool or pattern that reports a generator's additions apart from omissions; closest is LLM-Sim's 'Added'/'Modified' state-difference JSON (arXiv 2406.06485), which records world state changes, not description coverage.

candidates.name: Classify not_modeled items after the fact
candidates.misses: Needs regex over prose or an extra AI call per build.
candidates.reason: Core rule forbids regex on prose; the designer already knows which is which, so a field fixes it at the origin.

candidates.name: LLM-Sim state-difference output
candidates.covers: A JSON shape that separates added items from changed ones.
candidates.misses: It is about state changes during a step, not what a builder added beyond a user's description; nothing to install.
candidates.reason: Only the idea of a separate 'added' list carries over, and that is one field in our own contract.
